question: What order will you run these in? what crew members will you use?
brief: Given in chat after the commander introduced cockpit.constitution (2026-09-24), which replaces cockpit.keep, and the pilot's thoughts, gaps and regressions on it. Five records in one message: four CO, one CA, one CQ. The old records are Or001 to Or084 (commander/orders/), CA001 to CA005 (commander/desk/out/advice/), De001 to De028 (commander/decisions/). The commander wrote two questions in one line; the pilot kept them as one record and answered the order in XD-001 and the crew in XD-002 to XD-005, one per order.
